title: Saudi Stew with Turnip
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Saudi Arabia, featuring tender turnip and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until softened.
Add minced garlic and sauté for an additional minute.
Add the Arabian stew spice and stir for 1 minute.
Add turnip, tomato, and water to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer.
Let the stew cook for 30 minutes or until turnip is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
